added.title: Director of Product, Growth
added.description:
Role Summary

We're looking for a Director of Growth to lead our Product organization focused on customer and business growth for McAfee. This is a high-ownership leadership role responsible for how customers discover, buy, and stay subscribed to our products. You'll own the customer commerce funnel: conversion, monetization, and retention of a global, direct-to-consumer subscription business.

This is the right role for someone who is obsessed with the customer experience, thinks in experiments and segmentation, is fluent in the economics of subscriptions (conversion, AOV, retention, LTV, ARPU, churn), and can turn a roadmap of products, capabilities, and optimizations into measurable revenue. You'll lead a high performing growth PM team and partner closely with marketing, payments, finance, and legal to grow revenue and strengthen retention.

This is a Hybrid position located in New York, New York, Frisco, Texas or Newport Beach, CA. You will be required to be onsite on an as needed basis likely a few times a month. When you are not working onsite you will work from your home office. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance of New York, New York, Frisco, TX or Newport Beach, CA and are not offering relocation assistance.

Position Details

What You'll Own

The full-funnel growth strategy across acquisition, conversion, monetization, and retention with clear, quantified targets each quarter.
The end-to-end purchase experience across desktop and mobile web, desktop and mobile apps, retail channel, and the conversion rate it drives.
Pricing & packaging - support testing and launching new plans and offers, and their impact on ARPU and take-rate.
Subscriber retention and LTV, including renewal, payment method optimization, win-back, and monetization programs.
The growth dashboard and KPI targets (conversion rate, revenue, ARPU, LTV, churn/retention, fraud reduction).
The Growth team - its talent bar, experimentation maturity, and bench of future leaders.

What You'll Do

Set the growth strategy and translate it into a prioritized roadmap with measurable quarterly goals.
Build and scale an experimentation engine - hypothesis, design, statistical rigor, and a fast learn-and-ship cadence of A/B tests.
Optimize the purchase experience to maximize conversion and reduce friction across markets and devices.
Design and run pricing, offer, and packaging tests that grow ARPU and take-rate without eroding conversion or retention.
Drive retention and LTV through data-informed onsite and in-app interventions.
Lead, mentor, and grow the team, raising the bar for talent and developing future leaders.
Partner cross-functionally with eCommerce, marketing, payments, data, and finance to turn new capabilities and customer experiences into compounding commercial wins.
Report results transparently to leadership and hold the team accountable to outcomes.

What We're Looking For

10+ years in growth, product, monetization, or eCommerce, with 3+ years leading and developing teams.
Proven track record growing a subscription or D2C eCommerce business - measurable impact on conversion, retention, and LTV.
Deep fluency in subscription economics and metrics: revenue, LTV, ARPU, churn/retention cohorts, and customer segmentation.
Hands-on experience building and running an experimentation program (A/B and multivariate testing) and making decisions from data.
Strong command of pricing & packaging strategy and offer design for recurring revenue.
Experience optimizing purchase and conversion flows, ideally across websites and apps across multiple geographies.
Comfort working closely with engineering, payments, marketing/lifecycle, data, and finance.
Excellent communicator who can set strategy, align stakeholders, and hold a team accountable to outcomes.

Company Overview

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

Company Benefits And Perks

We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.:

Bonus Program
401k Retirement
Medical, Dental, Vision, Basic Life, Short Term Disability and Long-Term Disability Coverage
Paid Parental Leave
Support and Community Involvement
14 Paid Company Holidays
Unlimited Paid Time Off for Exempt Employees
96 Hours of Sick Time and 120 Hours of Vacation for Non-Exempt Employees Accrued Each Year

We're serious about our commitment to diversity which is why McAfee prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

Pay Range

The anticipated compensation for this position is USD $141,680.00/Yr. - USD $232,760.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications.

added.title: Product Management Senior Director
added.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Product

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Senior Director, PM - AI Agent Systems

AI agents can reason about what needs to happen. Getting them to reliably do work inside the software businesses actually run on is the next frontier.

We’re building Systems Integration Agent: computer use for the enterprise. It learns how to operate applications like SAP, Oracle, and Workday, then turns that knowledge into reusable, code-backed actions. The challenge goes beyond making an impressive demo: customers need automation they can trust with consequential business processes.

Our team operates as a small startup within Salesforce AI Labs, separate from the main engineering and product organizations. You’ll work directly with the team’s leader and engineers, alongside customers, with the autonomy to shape an early product and the resources of Salesforce to back you up.

As Senior Director of Product Management, you’ll help turn early production success into a repeatable product business. This is a hands-on product leadership role that includes spending time with customers, making difficult prioritization decisions, shaping the experience, and carrying those decisions through launch and adoption. You should be as comfortable investigating a failed customer workflow as presenting the product strategy to executive leadership.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Build Directly With Customers

Work alongside enterprise customers to understand their processes, identify valuable automation opportunities, and define what successful execution actually means.
Partner with engineering and forward-deployed engineers to take workflows from initial exploration through production adoption.
Distinguish customer-specific requirements from recurring needs that deserve investment in the core product.
Establish credible measures of customer value, including time saved, operational cost, reliability, and ongoing maintenance.

Own Product Strategy and Prioritization

Shape the product vision, roadmap, and sequencing across agent learning, execution, evaluation, governance, and self-service.
Decide where to focus first: which customers, systems, and workflows offer the strongest combination of customer value and repeatable adoption.
Make explicit tradeoffs between winning a new customer and building capabilities that make the next ten deployments easier.
Translate customer requirements and technical constraints into clear product decisions.

Make Powerful Technology Usable and Trustworthy

Partner with engineering and design to make recording, building, testing, debugging, and operating workflows accessible to the people who own those processes.
Define how users understand what an agent can do, verify its results, recover from failures, and retain control over consequential actions.
Establish product-level success criteria and release gates grounded in task completion, correctness, intervention rates, and time to value.
Build a path from hands-on onboarding toward increasingly self-service adoption.

Take the Product to Market

Partner with Salesforce stakeholders across product marketing, sales, pricing, security, and legal to bring the offering to market.
Shape positioning, packaging, and the customer journey from first demonstration to evaluation, purchase, and production use.
Build a growth strategy that connects enterprise buying decisions with hands-on technical validation and practitioner credibility.
Keep leadership aligned on the investment needed, the evidence behind the strategy, and the decisions that will determine what happens next.

You’re Our Person If…

You’ve taken an enterprise software product from ambiguity into production adoption. You can explain the decisions you owned, what customers actually used, and how the product changed after launch.
You have hands-on experience bringing AI-powered products to users. You understand why model quality alone is insufficient and can reason about evaluation, reliability, latency, cost, and human oversight.
You are technically fluent. You can engage deeply with engineers on agent behavior, APIs, workflow state, permissions, and failure recovery without needing to be the implementation owner.
You build directly with customers. You can move between a CIO’s business objectives and a process owner’s daily work, turning both into focused product decisions.
You demonstrate senior product judgment. You’ve owned consequential roadmap and investment tradeoffs, aligned teams without relying on reporting lines, and stayed accountable for outcomes.
You want to remain hands-on. You’re comfortable testing the product, writing precise requirements, investigating failures, and doing the detailed work required to get an early product right.

Helpful Experience

Enterprise automation, integration platforms, RPA, developer tools, or agent-based products.
Products used across systems such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, or Salesforce.
Combining enterprise sales with self-service evaluation or product-led adoption.
Working with forward-deployed engineering teams.
Growing a zero-to-one product within a startup or an incubation team.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Role Description

AI Labs is building an emerging product that changes how Salesforce itself gets built and run. The fastest way to prove it works is to run it on ourselves first. Salesforce is customer zero.

We are looking for a Senior Director to serve as Chief Operating Officer for this business. You coordinate every go to market team that touches the product: Sales, Customer Success, Partners, and Professional Services. Four organizations, one plan, one cadence, one set of numbers. Your job is to turn a promising product and four willing teams into a single repeatable motion, and to make Salesforce the first and best reference for what it does.

This is a build role. On day one there is a business to run and very little machinery to run it with, and you are the person who builds the machinery.

Responsibilities

Coordinate across all go to market teams. Own the operating plan that spans Sales, Success, Partners, and Professional Services. Clear rules of engagement, clear ownership, no duplicate coverage, no gaps between teams.
Make Salesforce customer zero. Own the internal rollout end to end: where we deploy first, who uses it, what we measure, and how quickly we fix what we find. Our own results become the proof the field sells with.
Run the operating cadence. Weekly, monthly, and quarterly reviews across pipeline, adoption, delivery, and internal rollout. Make every review a decision meeting, not a status meeting.
Own the numbers. One version of the truth for the business, sourced and current, with a clear line between measured results and estimates. These are the figures we take to Finance and to our executive sponsors.
Clear the path. Keep legal, security review, deal desk, and customer paper ahead of demand so that nobody waits on process to build with a customer.
Land what we bring in. Bring new teams, tools, and acquired capabilities into one plan, one roadmap, and one set of measures. Land the people as carefully as the technology.
Team. Hire and lead a small, senior operations team. Few people, high judgment, wide scope.

Required Experiences & Skills

Experience. 12+ years in business operations, sales operations, strategy and operations
Cross functional command. You have run a motion that spanned sales, post sale, services, and partners at the same time, and you got four leaders to run the same play.
Zero to one. You have built an operating plan and a cadence for a business that did not have one, inside a company large enough to have opinions about both.
People management. 5+ years leading teams, including senior individual contributors.
Internal deployment. You have driven an internal rollout of a product or system at scale, and you know the difference between a launch and adoption.
Claim discipline. You distinguish a measured result from an anecdote, and you say which is which before anyone asks. Your executive figures survive scrutiny.
Influence. You are a trusted partner to senior leaders across Sales, Success, Services, Product, Finance, and Legal, and you build agreement without formal authority.
Preferred. Salesforce platform familiarity. Experience operating a consumption based business. Experience supporting an acquisition integration.
Education. Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience required.

added.description:
Ready to take your career global?

At Global Payments, you power the technology behind millions of everyday transactions. From local shops to global brands, our platforms help businesses move money, grow faster and create better experiences for their customers. Join us and you step into a company that is shaping the future of commerce at scale.

As Director of Product Marketing for Genius
, our fast-growing point of sale (POS) business, you will shape how small businesses discover, adopt and succeed with our solutions. You will work alongside product, sales, marketing and commercialization teams to bring innovation to market and unlock growth across key segments.

You will join a high-energy, global team that thrives on curiosity, collaboration and results. Here, your ideas move quickly from concept to impact, and your leadership influences how we win in one of the most dynamic areas of the payments industry.

In this role, you’ll define how Genius shows up in the market, accelerate adoption across growing segments and lead the strategies that drive revenue growth. You will build and scale product marketing excellence, empower teams to win and play a key role in shaping how small businesses experience the future of commerce.

What You’ll Own

Shape and scale the go-to-market strategy for Genius, driving product adoption, revenue growth and market share across priority customer segments
Lead and grow a high-performing team of product marketers, creating a culture of ownership, innovation and continuous development
Define differentiated product positioning and messaging that clearly communicates value and wins in competitive markets
Orchestrate product launches that deliver measurable impact, from awareness through to product usage and commercial success
Build segmentation frameworks that unlock new growth opportunities, using data to identify high-potential markets and expansion paths
Turn market, customer and competitive insights into clear strategies that influence product direction and business outcomes
Enable sales teams to win by creating impactful tools, narratives and experiences that strengthen the buyer journey and accelerate deal success
Track and optimize performance, using insights such as win rates and adoption metrics to continuously improve strategy and deliver results

What You Bring

8+ years of experience in product marketing, with a strong track record of driving go-to-market success and product growth
Proven success launching and scaling products within multinational or global organizations
Deep understanding of the retail industry and point of sale ecosystems
Strong commercial mindset with the ability to translate market insights into growth strategies and measurable outcomes
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders across product, sales and marketing
Analytical thinking and financial acumen, with the ability to size markets and prioritize opportunities effectively
A collaborative, ownership-driven mindset with the confidence to lead, challenge and create impact

Our Perks - What We’ll Bring For You

We know it’s bigger than just your career. It’s your life, and your world. That’s why we offer global benefits and programs to support you at every stage. Here’s a taste of what you can expect.

A competitive salary and benefits package that recognizes your contribution
Opportunities to grow your skills and build your career within a global business
Access to learning, development and on-the-job experiences that expand your expertise
A supportive, inclusive team environment where your ideas and input matter
Time to give back through community and charity initiatives
A global employee assistance programme to support your wellbeing
Recognition through a global platform that celebrates your achievements

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

added.title: VP Product Management, Teaching and Learning (OnCourse)
added.description:
Clarivate is seeking a Vice President, Teaching & Learning to shape and scale onCourse, our AI-native platform designed to help higher education institutions transform teaching, learning, curriculum intelligence, and student success. This is a high-impact opportunity for a product-led, commercially minded executive to build a new growth business by pairing deep higher education market expertise with Clarivate’s trusted university relationships, differentiated content and data assets, global commercial reach, and scale.

About You – Experience, Education, Skills, And Accomplishments

10+ years of leadership experience in higher education technology, enterprise edtech, digital learning, curriculum technology, SaaS, or a closely related market.
5+ years of experience leading product management, product strategy, business unit, or general management functions.
Demonstrated experience launching, building, repositioning, or scaling a software product, product line, platform, or new venture.
Experience owning or contributing to product strategy, roadmap prioritization, pricing, go-to-market planning, pipeline development, or sales enablement.
Experience working directly with higher education institutions, university leaders, enterprise customers, strategic partners, design partners, or early adopters.
Experience leading cross-functional teams across product management, product marketing, sales, technology, finance, operations, or customer-facing functions.

It would be great if you also have . . .

Business-unit, general management, founder, or startup leadership experience.
Experience taking a business from early validation to meaningful commercial scale.
Familiarity with AI-enabled teaching and learning, curriculum intelligence, learning analytics, or emerging education platforms.
Strong understanding of institutional buying, enterprise sales cycles, customer adoption, implementation realities, and commercial execution.
Established relationships and credibility across the higher education market, including a network of institutional leaders, partners, influencers, or potential early adopters.
Ability to influence investment decisions, align senior stakeholders, and communicate clearly with executives, customers, partners, and internal teams.

What will you be doing in this role?

Own the business strategy, product direction, market development, commercialization, customer adoption, and revenue growth for onCourse and related Teaching & Learning opportunities.
Define market focus, customer segments, value proposition, growth model, investment priorities, and the path from launch to repeatable adoption and revenue scale.
Set product vision and roadmap priorities in partnership with Technology, grounded in customer needs, market opportunity, and commercial goals.
Lead customer discovery, design partner engagement, and product-market fit validation to focus on capabilities that drive adoption.
Own the revenue plan, go-to-market approach, pricing, pipeline strategy, and sales enablement model in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Technology.
Develop executive relationships with universities, design partners, early adopters, and strategic prospects to accelerate validation, pipeline creation, and market credibility.
Drive pipeline creation, deal progression, customer conversion, and predictable commercial performance.
Lead an integrated team across sales, product management, and product marketing while partnering closely with technology, content, AI, finance, and operations.
Align senior leaders around the business case, market opportunity, investment needs, and path to growth.

About The Team

The Teaching & Learning business is focused on creating AI-powered solutions that help higher education institutions improve teaching, learning, curriculum intelligence, adoption, and student success. This role will work closely with leaders and teams across product management, product marketing, sales, technology, content, AI, finance, and operations to bring onCourse and related opportunities to market.

Hours of Work

This is a full-time position, primarily working core business hours in your time zone, with flexibility to adjust to various global time zones as needed. Work arrangement and office expectations should be confirmed based on the approved posting location.

added.title: Director, Product Design - AI & Context
added.description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We're looking for an experienced Design Leader to oversee our Context Platform Pillar, which homes several critical company initiatives including Design Systems, Code, MCP, CMS, Community, and more. Think of it as the team that drives the most important context for AI agents to help you design better products.

In this role, you'll tackle strategic challenges from building new products to evolving and scaling existing ones - all while empowering your teams to deliver ambitious, high-quality work. If you're a leader who is especially deep in understanding modern AI + Design Systems workflows, and very passionate about empowering Designers through platform-wide investments in Figma's ecosystem, this role is for you.

As a Design leader at Figma, you'll guide and grow a team of world-class designers, with the opportunity to expand this group as the scope and impact of our work evolves. In this deeply cross-functional role, you'll work in close collaboration with product management, engineering, research, marketing, and other teams to shape both product and business strategy in our next chapter.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you'll do at Figma:

Hire, manage, and develop a multi-team design group spanning Design Systems, Code, MCP, CMS, and Community
Partner with Product and Engineering leads in this area to improve team processes and execution and coach individual teams through setting roadmap and strategy
Develop a perspective on your team's product areas and successfully advocate for it across the organization
Lead critique, sprint, and design review practices across the pillar
Advance your own skills at people management in a supportive and growth-oriented environment
Operate hands-on across both people management and strategy and execution

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

5+ years of design management experience, ideally including experience managing managers and leading teams through ambiguity and change
Deep understanding of the latest AI developments, modern tooling, and component-driven design practices
Strong hands-on expertise with Figma's tools, with the ability to mentor and guide design teams effectively
Proven track record of partnering cross-functionally to solve complex design challenges and drive meaningful outcomes
Strong strategic thinking and communication skills, demonstrated through influencing teams, adapting quickly, and taking a proactive, solution-oriented approach

While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:

Background contributing to open-source or developer-facing design tools
Experience partnering with Research and Marketing on platform-wide initiatives

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Pay Transparency Disclosure

Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location.

Figma offers equity to employees, as well as a competitive package of additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits with company contributions; parental leave and reproductive or family planning support; mental health and wellness benefits; and paid time off. Figma provides paid sick leave, holidays, and other leave benefits in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the requirements of the Washington Minimum Wage Act and related regulations. Exempt employees are eligible for employer‑provided paid flexible PTO in addition to flexible paid sick leave. PTO is subject to manager approval. Additional benefits may include company recharge days, cell phone and home internet reimbursements, and a number of lifestyle spending accounts. Figma also offers sales incentive compensation for most sales roles and an annual bonus plan for eligible non-sales roles. All compensation and benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and may be modified by Figma at any time, consistent with applicable law.

Annual Base Salary Range:

added.description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Senior Product Manager to join our FinTech Team, focusing on payments. FinTech is a key area of investment for the company and a cornerstone of our future growth. As the successful candidate, we will rely on your honed product management skills combined with your experience in the Fintech space to shape the trajectory of this product. This role can be performed remotely across Canada or the US (some exceptions may apply).

Product Management at Clio:

Clio’s mission is to ‘transform the legal experience for all.’ If you’re into ‘mission-driven’ product management this might be the place for you!

Our market opportunity is rare in its scale and powered by a strong business model, Silicon Valley based investors and advisors, and a product management team which is global and world-class (if we do say so ourselves)! Clio is growing rapidly with massive growth opportunities for Product Managers.

Speaking of Product at Clio… we’ve worked hard to develop an excellent product management culture with empowered PMs who are highly regarded and influential within the organization. Our team is composed of seasoned professionals from a diverse set of product backgrounds. Clio invests heavily in developing Product Managers, growing leaders and in the broader Product communities in which we operate.

We pride ourselves on being ‘human and high performing’ and creating a workplace where you can be challenged, supported and bring your whole self to work.

What you’ll work on:

Product Leadership

As a Senior Product Manager and in conjunction with your Developer and Designer counterparts (your triad) you will drive successful outputs and outcomes in your product area. Working from the overarching strategy set by your Senior Director of Product, you will develop a strategic roadmap in conjunction with your peers that moves our business forward and evangelize this throughout the company.

Strategy and Prioritization

You will drive customer and market research, identify opportunities, develop unbiased business cases and determine priorities that help Clio best deliver on our mission and against our annual OKRs. You will build conviction in the initiatives that you chose to invest in and be willing to pivot when priorities change or new information comes to light.

Market and Customer Understanding

We truly believe that the success of our customers comes first so expectations for Product Managers to be the expert on the user is high. As such, constant communication with customers, (existing, churned and prospect) as well as a deep understanding of the markets in which we operate will be expected. This will be complemented by deep quantitative data to complete the customer picture.

Coaching and Mentoring

Clio will look to you to coach and mentor other Product Managers in their craft and, in conjunction with product leadership, contribute to the continuous up-levelling of the product function as a whole.

What you have:

A fintech background (payments, billing, and accounting preferred) with solid financial literacy skills
Experience autonomously developing a strategic roadmap with measurable business impact
A significant number of successes and failures under your belt; the learnings of which you can bring to Clio
Can work in a highly collaborative team without ego
Have the ability to foster strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels within the organization
Have experience using data to inform decisions without succumbing to analysis paralysis
Have the ability to thrive and deliver while surrounded by chaos and ambiguity
Have the genuine ability to put yourself in our customers’ shoes and operate from a place of empathy
Are enthusiastic to learn a new, complex domain and the humility to ask for help when needed
Have a track record of breaking down objectives into initiatives and delivering to customers at scale

Serious bonus points if you have:

Proven experience participating in building and scaling a payments business
Demonstrable experience self serving answers, insights and data from a variety of data analytics tools

This is a new role.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:

Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

The expected salary range for this role is $137,500 to $186,100 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers

At Flexcar, our mission is to make car ownership flexible, affordable, and enjoyable for everyone. We’ve created a month-to-month option that is more affordable than buying and more flexible than leasing. Our members are saving money and choosing a model that fits how real life actually works. Building a better model of car ownership takes more than technology. It takes people who value clarity, fairness, and real human experience.

Flexcar is looking for a Senior PM to join its fast-moving product team and take on high-impact IC work across multiple product verticals. You’ll be tasked with getting up to speed on Flexcar’s business model, deeply understanding our customers’ needs, and moving some of our most important product work forward. This isn't a role where you'll be handed a pre-scoped roadmap to execute against: you'll be identifying opportunities with the clearest value, building the business case, executing across whichever combination of engineering, design, operations, and cross-functional partners the problem requires, and reading out on impact.

The right person for this role is energized by that level of ownership, excited to take on that responsibility within a business that is rapidly growing, and eager to grow a skillset that extends beyond the traditional PM role
.

What You'll Do

Own product areas end-to-end.
You'll be accountable for outcomes across one or more product verticals. What "shipping" looks like varies week to week: sometimes it's a significant feature launch, sometimes it's a policy change, a process redesign, or an analysis that unlocks the next decision.

Contribute in a variety of ways.
At Flexcar, features get built in a lot of different ways, with different engineers, different cross-functional partners, and sometimes with you writing the first version yourself. You'll be comfortable moving between those modes, and equally comfortable closing the loop: pulling the data, building the rationale, and assessing whether what shipped moved the needle.

Work in the in-between spaces.
A lot of our highest-leverage product work happens before and after major launches: deep problem definition, stakeholder alignment, competitive research, building out pilots, and post-launch learning. You'll be expected to find and own that work without being told to.

Execute through cross-functional collaboration.
You’ll need to communicate your ideas clearly and build trust across the organization. Software development at Flexcar has a broad impact and ensuring that all teams are along for the ride will be a priority.

Build with AI, thoughtfully.
We've scaled AI tooling quickly across the team. We expect Senior PMs to be able to write and ship basic code, prototype designs, and build solutions in our agentic infrastructure. That said, the tools are the easy part: we are focused on finding critical thinkers who pursue creative solutions.

Required

What We're Looking For

Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience
5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2–3 years owning a product area independently without requiring heavy support or direction
Proven capacity to build seamlessly with partners in engineering and design
Strong analytical instincts and genuine comfort with data. You should be the kind of person who builds a data-driven case before forming an opinion
Track record of operating effectively in ambiguous or resource-constrained environments
Genuine AI curiosity: you've been using these tools in your actual workflow, not just experimenting
Demonstrated ownership mentality: you notice what's broken and fix it without being asked
Experience working with and influencing cross-functional stakeholders beyond a core squad (finance, marketing, operations, legal, vendors, etc.)

Nice to Have

Prior experience at a company with both significant technological and operational complexity
Prior experience working in a startup or similar growth-phase environment
Experience building or shipping AI-assisted features or tooling, using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and Claude Design

What Tops Off The Tank

Rest & Relaxation: Flexible PTO policy.
Future Savings: Benefit from a 401(k) plan with company match from day one.
Benefits: Excellent, low-cost healthcare coverage including: medical, dental, vision, eligibility day one.
Drive a Flexcar! Discounted employee rate on Flexcar products and no annual membership fee.
Weekly Pay
And other amazing perks!

updated.title: Principal Product Manager - MoneyLion Marketplace
updated.description:
About Gen

Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.

When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs.

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.

If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen.

About The Role

The Marketplace is where MoneyLion customers see their financial options and act on them. It brings together MoneyLion's own money tools and a wide range of partner products, and customers count on us for the full picture and a clear sense of what actually fits their situation. We care a lot about the trust customers extend to us, and about turning it into long-term relationships that grow with them as their financial lives change.

As Principal Product Manager, you'll take on the hardest, highest-stakes problems in the Marketplace, including the cross-cutting ones that shape where it heads and that no single team fully owns today. You'll set direction in your area and influence it well beyond, working through other teams as much as with your own. This is a hands-on role — you'll be in the details with your team day to day, not directing from a distance. The space is moving quickly, so reading customer and market signal and turning it into the bets we make next is a core part of the job. You'll report to the Director of Product.

Key Responsibilities

Own the most complex, cross-cutting problems in the Marketplace from problem to launch to iteration, and be accountable for how they move customer and business outcomes.
Set the strategy and roadmap for your area, and make the case for the bets worth making.
Take on ambiguous problems before they're well defined. Frame them so other teams can move in parallel, and set the direction they build against.
Work closely with design, engineering, and data science to ship, and partner with research and analytics to understand what customers actually do.
Build buy-in across the company, and collaborate with partners and adjacent teams (covering both B2C and B2B).
Raise the bar for product craft around you.
Use experimentation to learn quickly and iterate.
Have a real point of view on where AI belongs in the Marketplace, from more personal and timely guidance to experiences customers trust with their money.
Use AI as a teammate in your day-to-day to raise product quality and team speed.

Experience

About you:

8+ years of product management experience, including consumer apps, with a track record of taking hard, ambiguous problems from unclear to shipped and scaled.

What You'll Bring

A strong feel for UX and what "good" is for consumers, and the judgment to push for it.
Fluency with data. You use it to find problems, size opportunities, and decide, and you know when the numbers aren't enough.
An experimentation mindset. You'd rather test a real question than argue about it.
Comfortable driving work across teams you don't own.
Hands-on experience using AI in your own workflow, and a point of view on where it belongs in the product.
Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to build alignment across teams.
Experience building B2C products.

Nice To Have

Background in fintech, or in another regulated, trust-heavy consumer space such as insurance or healthcare.
Experience with marketplace products.
B2B exposure, or familiarity partnering with B2B-facing teams.

Personal Attributes

Genuinely curious about personal finance and how people make decisions about money.
Highly empathetic. You start from the customer's situation, not the feature.
At home with complexity and a natural systems thinker. You can hold a lot of moving parts in your head and reason about how they connect.
Tuned in to where consumer software is heading and what the best products are doing.
Comfortable when the path isn't fully mapped, and willing to do the unglamorous work to unblock the team.

Location: New York, NY (Onsite 3 days per week)

Compensation

The annual base salary for this position is expected to be between $200,000 and $250,000. Base salary is one component of Gen's total compensation package, which includes 401(k) match, health insurance options, disability coverage, life insurance, and unlimited paid time off. Actual salaries will vary based on a candidate's qualifications, experience, skills, and competencies related to the role.

What’s Next

Your CV will be reviewed together by the recruiter and hiring manager to assess the scope of your role, the impact you’ve delivered, and how your experience aligns with the position. If shortlisted, the recruiter will invite you to an initial Zoom conversation to discuss your background, what’s compelling you to Gen, and walk you through the interview process.

Important Application Note – When you apply, please include your current city and country and let us know your work status (e.g. visa status, right to work in the relevant country, etc.).

Gen is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to fair, inclusive practices at every stage of the candidate and employee journey. Employment decisions are based on merit, experience and business needs.

TA Screen
Assignment
Hiring Manager Interview
Cross-Functional Panel (individual interviews with Design, Engineering Lead, and Data/Marketing)
Executive Interview
